First of all, it doesn't show my account the amount of hours I have in this as I only recently downloaded the Steam version. I've been playing since Beta and have 4.6k hours on my profile in-game (and it only counts time spent in missions.)

To begin, the game is a true F2P game, you do not have to spend a single cent in the game to have absolutely everything (some cosmetics are for real money but they don't serve any real purpose other than you looking amazing.)

So lets start with the pro's:
- There is so much content in the game that you won't run out of things do for probably ever.
- The game is somewhat easy to understand and to get a grasp off.
- Customization is unparalleled, you can make whatever you feel like.
- DE listens to the community, which is rare in games these days, and improves things on the daily basis with patches and bugfixes.
- If you like crowd massacres, there is too much of it in the game, making you feel like a god when you're in a mission.
- The trading system  is the most polished and easy to do in any game I played.
- One of the best communities out there.

Con's, there are some but not many:
- Its not really beginner friendly, if you can get thru the first 100 hours or so, you should be fine.
- It isn't always fun to play when some high level player joins your game and kills everything on his own, and you are just running around aimlesly.
- The game is a real, true, massive grind, can take days upon days of constant grind to get an item you need or want (I do like that tho)
- It is heavily impacted by RNG in every aspect of the game.

This is not a game to play casually, if you wanna get anywhere with it, you need to invest a lot of time into it, but in the end, if you like grinding and doing the same thing hundreds of times, this is a game for you.
